capabilities: Create and edit spreadsheets saved as .sheet files in the vault
Use around 280 Excel functions with autocomplete and a function picker
Format cells with fonts, colors, borders, merged cells, and a format painter
Import .xlsx and .csv files and export sheets to .xlsx
Switch sheets between right-to-left and left-to-right layout
disambiguation: Not a connector to Microsoft Excel files or services; it builds its own spreadsheet view inside Obsidian and only imports/exports .xlsx.
extras: The plugin page carries a Caution rating; the README explains it comes from repeated CSS lint warnings (!important) in the bundled Handsontable stylesheet, not the plugin's own code. Installation is manual (copy files into the plugins folder); no community marketplace install steps are given.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spreadsheet, so working with tabular data and formulas means leaving the vault or juggling external files.

relations.evidence: the grid library the spreadsheet is built on, which is bundled into styles.css

summary: Spreadsheet plugin that creates and edits .sheet files in the vault with formulas, cell formatting, RTL support, and .xlsx/.csv import and export.
